name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
description: PM SVANidhi is a micro-credit scheme launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs to provide collateral-free working capital loans to street vendors to resume and expand their livelihoods.
benefits: Provides initial working capital loan up to ₹10,000; second tranche up to ₹20,000; and third tranche up to ₹50,000 upon timely repayment. Offers an interest subsidy of 7% per annum credited quarterly to the beneficiary's bank account, plus monthly cashback up to ₹100 for digital transactions.
eligibility: Available to all street vendors, hawkers, and cart vendors engaged in vending in urban and peri-urban areas on or before the qualifying scheme dates, possessing a Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from local Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).
documents: Aadhaar card, Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Urban Local Body, active bank account passbook, and Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
application_process: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or visit a nearby Common Service Center (CSC). Authenticate using Aadhaar, submit vending details, select your preferred lending institution, and submit.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Urban and peri-urban street vendors and hawkers
